kurz: The yeast-dough man for St Nicholas Day is a Zopf dough in a shape: kneading builds the network, rest lets it rise, egg yolk makes it shiny and brown.
bild_im_kopf: Like a balloon given a shape: the gas inflates it, the skin decides the figure.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Knead flour, milk, butter, yeast, sugar and salt for 10 minutes
schluesselmomente.warum: Kneading builds the gluten network that will later hold the yeast's gas.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Leave covered until doubled in size
schluesselmomente.warum: The yeast produces gas and flavour. Milk and butter make the dough soft and the crust tender.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Shape the figure, cut arms and legs, leave to rise briefly again
schluesselmomente.warum: The second short proof relaxes the dough; otherwise the cuts tear open untidily.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Brush with egg yolk, bake at about 200 °C for 20–25 minutes (as a guide)
schluesselmomente.warum: Egg yolk, [[milchzucker|lactose]] and butter brown quickly into a glossy crust.
